title: High Performance Web Sites and YSlow
summary: A Google Tech Talk on Yahoo's 14 rules for faster web pages and the YSlow tool. It covers front-end practices like avoiding @import and fixing ETags, with live analysis of popular sites.
why: Praised as solid, research-backed advice on front-end web performance.

quote.text: Everything they produce about the subject (and I don't just mean the plugin) is solid gold.
